faq.q: How much does Grauman Law charge?
faq.a: Grauman Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Grauman Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Grauman Law publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Grauman Law have offices?
faq.a: Grauman Law publishes one office, in Kew Gardens. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Grauman Law?
faq.a: Grauman Law names eight attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 5 of 8 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 3 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Grauman Law?
faq.a: Grauman Law scores 50 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint.
